WITH viewer AS ( WITH raw_statistics AS ( SELECT round(avg(viewer_count))::int AS average_viewers, max(viewer_count)::int AS peak_viewers FROM viewer_metrics WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} ), platform_count AS ( SELECT count(DISTINCT coalesce(platform_session_id, -1)) AS value FROM viewer_metrics WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} ), latest_by_platform_minute AS ( SELECT platform_session_id, date_trunc('minute', measured_at) AS minute, (array_agg(viewer_count ORDER BY measured_at DESC))[1] AS viewer_count FROM viewer_metrics WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} GROUP BY platform_session_id, date_trunc('minute', measured_at) ), combined AS ( SELECT minute, sum(viewer_count) AS viewer_count FROM latest_by_platform_minute GROUP BY minute ), combined_statistics AS ( SELECT round(avg(viewer_count))::int AS average_viewers, max(viewer_count)::int AS peak_viewers FROM combined ) SELECT CASE WHEN p.value <= 1 THEN r.average_viewers ELSE c.average_viewers END AS average_viewers, CASE WHEN p.value <= 1 THEN r.peak_viewers ELSE c.peak_viewers END AS peak_viewers FROM raw_statistics r CROSS JOIN platform_count p CROSS JOIN combined_statistics c ), chat AS ( SELECT count(*) AS total_chat, count(sentiment_label) AS analyzed_chat, count(*) FILTER (WHERE sentiment_label = 'JOY') AS joy_count, count(*) FILTER (WHERE sentiment_label = 'EXCITEMENT') AS excitement_count, count(*) FILTER (WHERE sentiment_label = 'SUPPORT') AS support_count, count(*) FILTER (WHERE sentiment_label = 'SURPRISE') AS surprise_count, count(*) FILTER (WHERE sentiment_label = 'SADNESS') AS sadness_count, count(*) FILTER (WHERE sentiment_label = 'ANGER') AS anger_count, count(*) FILTER (WHERE sentiment_label = 'CONFUSION') AS confusion_count, count(*) FILTER (WHERE sentiment_label = 'NEUTRAL') AS neutral_count FROM chat_messages WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} ) SELECT v.average_viewers, v.peak_viewers, c.total_chat, c.analyzed_chat, c.joy_count, c.excitement_count, c.support_count, c.surprise_count, c.sadness_count, c.anger_count, c.confusion_count, c.neutral_count FROM viewer v CROSS JOIN chat c
mapper.update: UPDATE reports SET avg_viewers = #{statistics.averageViewers}, peak_viewers = #{statistics.peakViewers}, total_chat = #{statistics.totalChat}, analyzed_chat = #{statistics.analyzedChat}, joy_count = #{statistics.joyCount}, excitement_count = #{statistics.excitementCount}, support_count = #{statistics.supportCount}, surprise_count = #{statistics.surpriseCount}, sadness_count = #{statistics.sadnessCount}, anger_count = #{statistics.angerCount}, confusion_count = #{statistics.confusionCount}, neutral_count = #{statistics.neutralCount} WHERE id = #{reportId} AND status = 'PROCESSING'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO report_platform_metrics ( report_id, platform_session_id, avg_viewers, peak_viewers, total_chat, analyzed_chat, joy_count, excitement_count, support_count, surprise_count, sadness_count, anger_count, confusion_count, neutral_count, broadcast_seconds, viewer_coverage, data_quality ) WITH viewer AS ( SELECT platform_session_id, round(avg(viewer_count))::int AS avg_viewers, max(viewer_count)::int AS peak_viewers, count(DISTINCT date_trunc('minute', measured_at)) AS observed_minutes FROM viewer_metrics WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} GROUP BY platform_session_id ), chat AS ( SELECT platform_session_id, count(*) AS total_chat, count(sentiment_label) AS analyzed_chat, count(*) FILTER (WHERE sentiment_label = 'JOY') AS joy_count, count(*) FILTER (WHERE sentiment_label = 'EXCITEMENT') AS excitement_count, count(*) FILTER (WHERE sentiment_label = 'SUPPORT') AS support_count, count(*) FILTER (WHERE sentiment_label = 'SURPRISE') AS surprise_count, count(*) FILTER (WHERE sentiment_label = 'SADNESS') AS sadness_count, count(*) FILTER (WHERE sentiment_label = 'ANGER') AS anger_count, count(*) FILTER (WHERE sentiment_label = 'CONFUSION') AS confusion_count, count(*) FILTER (WHERE sentiment_label = 'NEUTRAL') AS neutral_count FROM chat_messages WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} GROUP BY platform_session_id ), source AS ( SELECT ps.id AS platform_session_id, greatest(0, extract(epoch FROM ( coalesce(ps.ended_at, bs.ended_at, now()) - coalesce(ps.started_at, bs.started_at) )))::bigint AS broadcast_seconds, coalesce(cap.support_status, 'SUPPORTED') AS viewer_support, ps.status FROM broadcast_platform_sessions ps JOIN broadcast_sessions bs ON bs.id = ps.broadcast_session_id LEFT JOIN platform_session_capability_runs cap ON cap.platform_session_id = ps.id AND cap.capability_code = 'VIEWER_METRICS' WHERE ps.broadcast_session_id = #{sessionId} ), calculated AS ( SELECT s.*, v.avg_viewers, v.peak_viewers, coalesce(v.observed_minutes, 0) AS observed_minutes, greatest(1, ceil(s.broadcast_seconds / 60.0)) AS expected_minutes, coalesce(c.total_chat, 0) AS total_chat, coalesce(c.analyzed_chat, 0) AS analyzed_chat, coalesce(c.joy_count, 0) AS joy_count, coalesce(c.excitement_count, 0) AS excitement_count, coalesce(c.support_count, 0) AS support_count, coalesce(c.surprise_count, 0) AS surprise_count, coalesce(c.sadness_count, 0) AS sadness_count, coalesce(c.anger_count, 0) AS anger_count, coalesce(c.confusion_count, 0) AS confusion_count, coalesce(c.neutral_count, 0) AS neutral_count FROM source s LEFT JOIN viewer v ON v.platform_session_id = s.platform_session_id LEFT JOIN chat c ON c.platform_session_id = s.platform_session_id ) SELECT #{reportId}, platform_session_id, avg_viewers, peak_viewers, total_chat, analyzed_chat, joy_count, excitement_count, support_count, surprise_count, sadness_count, anger_count, confusion_count, neutral_count, broadcast_seconds, CASE WHEN viewer_support = 'UNSUPPORTED' THEN NULL ELSE least(1, observed_minutes / expected_minutes)::numeric(5,4) END, CASE WHEN status = 'FAILED' THEN 'PARTIAL' WHEN viewer_support = 'SUPPORTED' AND observed_minutes / expected_minutes < 0.8 THEN 'PARTIAL' ELSE 'COMPLETE' END FROM calculated ON CONFLICT (report_id, platform_session_id) DO UPDATE SET avg_viewers = EXCLUDED.avg_viewers, peak_viewers = EXCLUDED.peak_viewers, total_chat = EXCLUDED.total_chat, analyzed_chat = EXCLUDED.analyzed_chat, joy_count = EXCLUDED.joy_count, excitement_count = EXCLUDED.excitement_count, support_count = EXCLUDED.support_count, surprise_count = EXCLUDED.surprise_count, sadness_count = EXCLUDED.sadness_count, anger_count = EXCLUDED.anger_count, confusion_count = EXCLUDED.confusion_count, neutral_count = EXCLUDED.neutral_count, broadcast_seconds = EXCLUDED.broadcast_seconds, viewer_coverage = EXCLUDED.viewer_coverage, data_quality = EXCLUDED.data_quality
